## History

Russell is mentioned in relation to the events surrounding the end of the term at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). During this time, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovers that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and that she herself has won the Avery scholarship. Russell's involvement contextually aligns with these academic milestones and the subsequent commencement events.
